notes.title: Game Release
notes.notes: We will be releasing the game today and making updates to it as interest grows. Although this is a discontinued project that we are bringing back, we will continue to make updates to the game as interest and involvement grows. Thank you everyone who showed their support thus far, it means a lot to us. Your continued support will also continue to encourage our efforts.

notes.title: Update to Server and Log In
notes.notes: There was an issue with the old server connection config that prevented you from logging into your local server. We have since updated that info and everything should work fine now. Simply log off of Steam and Log back in to force an update.
